- 3 reach -> 3 modes ✓

- 2 bit rates -> 25.78125 lanes/sensitivity, 103.1 reach ✓
- 2 tx -> 4.5 lane/sensitivity, 10.5 reach ✓
- 2 bands -> LAN WDM lane/sensitivity, 1310nm reach ✓
